title: OSCORE stores recreate missing rollback authority from mutable state
description: Security review of 0919/mamj: GatewayOscoreSenderStore::load and GatewayOscoreRecipientStore::load accept (state present, external floor missing) and recreate the floor from the ordinary state record. If the independent rollback authority is deleted/unmounted while a rolled-back state snapshot remains, startup silently establishes the attacker-controlled snapshot as the new floor. Fail closed whenever exactly one side exists; only (None,None) may initialize a fresh context. Add sender and recipient missing-floor restart tests.
close_reason: Already implemented in tree, both stores. GatewayOscoreRecipientStore::load (rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs:429-441): (None,None)->fresh empty; (None,Some) and (Some,None)->Err(Corrupt) — exactly-one-side fails closed; state-precedes-floor -> Corrupt; state!=floor re-commits floor. GatewayOscoreSenderStore::load (gateway.rs:536-554): identical fail-closed match, only (None,None) returns fresh. Restart tests present: sender missing-floor case in oscore_sender_sequence_store_rejects_tamper_and_rollback (deletes floor record, asserts Corrupt on reopen, gateway.rs:1783-1790); recipient missing-floor case in oscore_recipient_replay_store_survives_restart (deletes floor file, asserts is_replay->Corrupt, gateway.rs:1830-1840). All 5rx2-scoped tests pass (211/212 gateway lib tests; the single failure is the unrelated tunnel_auth revocation/replay classification drift, filed as project-LICHEN-worker6-ipbu). No files changed.
